note: Kentucky State Parks campground (Pleasant Ridge) on a wooded ridge about 35 m above Yatesville Lake; the lake is out of sight through the trees, and the shoreline sites are boat-in only. All 27 RV sites are back-ins in grassy clearings, and two are doubles for side-by-side rigs. Golf course and marina in the park. --Claude
summary: Kept. 27 W/E back-ins (15/30/50A), $34 Sun-Thu / $36 Fri-Sat / $38 holiday; showers, laundry, dump; season Mar 15 - Nov 15 (closed now, through Mar 14 2027). WATERFRONT DOWN recommended: lakeview -> not waterfront (RA flags every RV site 'Near Water - no'; no lake in any of 27 official site photos; pads 30-35 m above the lake 95-110 m away through continuous forest). Policy-row fee copies cleared; website fix.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE RECOMMENDED: stored lakeview -> not waterfront. Yatesville Lake summer pool 630 ft (192.0 m); 3DEP on the water 189.6-197.3 m. The nearest RV pads, the west end of the Greenbriar/Blaine Creek loop at ~38.0967,-82.6885, sit at 225 m, about 33 m above the pool, with the lake arm 95 m west and 110 m north through unbroken forest on a steep slope. ReserveAmerica tags all 27 RV sites 'Near Water - no' (only boat-in B01-B16 are 'Near Water'), and none of the 27 official site photos shows the lake - each pad sits in a grassy clearing ringed by trees. Old evidence ('pads strung along ridge above lake arm ~20-60m away behind tree band and bank drop') overstated how close the water is. Suggested evidence: 'Esri + 3DEP 2026-11-24: nearest RV pads (west loop, ~38.0967,-82.6885) at 225 m, 33 m above summer pool (192 m), lake 95-110 m away through continuous forest; RA flags every RV site Near Water - no; no lake in any of 27 RA site photos = not waterfront'.

STATUS/SEASON: RA 'Status: Closed through Sun Mar 14 2027' is the seasonal close, not a renovation (Yatesville is not on parks.ky.gov/improvements). Season 03-15..11-15 written (RA schedule; parks.ky.gov 'Open mid-March through mid-November').

SITES: RA lists 004, 017 and 027 with no electric icon, but their detail pages show 15/30/50 water/electric like the rest. Site 027 (accessible) shows 'No pricing information available'. Max Vehicle Length varies 22-35 ft by site, so it is real, not a placeholder. Site 023 is 22 ft (too short); every other RV site takes a 23-ft rig. No pull-throughs.
NOTE: old note's 'Reserve via Kentucky State Parks' dropped as policy-row boilerplate; 'some double-wide' kept as the park's 'double RV campsites'.
PIN 38.0968,-82.6824 sits at the campground entrance road where the loops meet; within ~250 m of every loop. Fine. PHONE 606-673-1492 matches parks.ky.gov.
POLICY ROW state:KY: RA page matches (1-night weekday minimum, Fri/Sat arrivals 2 nights, 12-month window, 4 adults + $5, max 8). No contradiction.
